scenes.script:
Sourav says: Bochorer por bochor expensive English classes e taka nosto korlam, tao interview-te freeze hoye jetam. Tarpor ami khunje pelam Supernova AI.
Sourav says: Ekhon ami Miss Nova-r sathe privately speaking practice kori. Uni shudhu amar jonne ekta custom plan baniye den, ar amar mistakes niye kokhono judge koren na!
scenes.on_screen_text:
Top: English classes e taka nosto koreo interview te freeze hoye kaddchi.

Bottom: Supernova AI-te Miss Nova-r sathe privately speaking practice korar por ami.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Changed character name Rahul to Sourav to match the Bengali casting table. Ensured the hook opens with native Bengali words ('Bochorer por bochor') rather than English. Used highly colloquial, WhatsApp-style romanized Bengali, avoiding any Sanskritized words like 'byaybahul' or 'shakkhatkar', replacing them with natural code-mixed English terms ('expensive', 'interview') as per T2 and T3.
